headline: Discussion of a median strip ordinance and municipal speed limit setting authority, plus Vision Zero program update.
summary: Public comment will be taken only on speed limit setting authority. Reports on the Commercial Street pilot and Payson Park traffic calming project are also scheduled.
items: Vision Zero program update and discussion of municipal speed limit setting authority and median strip ordinance (public comment on speed limit authority only)
Commercial Street Safe Streets Pilot Project report by Cashel Stewart, GPCOG (no public comment)
Payson Park Traffic Calming Demonstration Project report by Megan Houdlette and Alex Marshall (no public comment)
